title: Trivia Tokens
tagline: Trivia Token is the first AI-powered play-to-earn game. It leverages an AI chatbot with payment capabilities to generate questions, validate answers, and reward players.
description:
Trivia Token is the world's first AI-powered play-to-earn token. In its MVP, it is a Discord bot that rewards correct open-answer trivia responses with ERC-20 tokens on Base blockchain. This bot can be added to any Discord server by a server administrator who can prompt the bot to ask themed questions. Server users respond to the questions and instantly receive $TRIVIA rewards sent directly to their wallet. Server users and administrators can access the Trivia Token Website to stake tokens. Users benefit through financial rewards for their themed knowledge while administrators benefit from increased engagement in their communities.

In its future, Trivia Token bot will be added to other social media platforms, including X and Farcaster.
how_its_made:
I built this project using an AI-powered code editor, Cursor Composer with Claude 3.5-Sonnet. 

Automated question generation and user-friendly answer validation
Token economics with transaction taxes and staking requirements
React-based staking interface
Seamless deployment on Base, Coinbase's Ethereum L2
